library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

file_path <- "F:/мидийное/mussels morphology analysis/Морфометрия Витязь.xlsx"
txt_dir   <- "F:/мидийное/mussels_geom/geom_analysis/data"   # папка с txt-контурами

df_morph <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = 4)
New names:
• `` -> `...35`
• `` -> `...36`
• `` -> `...37`
df_morph <- df_morph[!is.na(df_morph$ID), ]

df_morph %>%
  mutate(category = case_when(`Structure_MG` <= 0.05 ~ "MT_pure",
                              `Structure_MG` <  0.25 & `Structure_MG` > 0.05 ~ "MT_like_hybrids",
                              `Structure_MG` <= 0.75 & `Structure_MG` >= 0.25 ~ "F1",
                              `Structure_MG` >  0.75 & `Structure_MG` < 0.95 ~ "MG_like_hybrids",
                              `Structure_MG` >= 0.95 ~ "MG_pure")) ->
  df_morph

df_morph |>
  mutate(category2 = case_when(`Structure_MG` <= 0.05 ~ "MT_pure",
                               `Structure_MG` <  0.25 & `Structure_MG` > 0.05 ~ "Hybrid",
                               `Structure_MG` <= 0.75 & `Structure_MG` >= 0.25 ~ "Hybrid",
                               `Structure_MG` >  0.75 & `Structure_MG` < 0.95 ~ "Hybrid",
                               `Structure_MG` >= 0.95 ~ "MG_pure")) ->
  df_morph
txt_files <- list.files(txt_dir, full.names = TRUE)
myt <- Out(import_txt(txt.paths = txt_files))
 * Extracting  85 ..txt coordinates...
coe_all <- efourier(myt, nb.h = 6, norm = TRUE)$coe

df_out <- as.data.frame(coe_all)
df_out$ID <- gsub(x = row.names(df_out), pattern = "v", replacement = "V")

df_all <- merge(df_morph, df_out, by = "ID")

df_mussel_param <- df_all |>
  select(ID, L, Z, Sex, Morphotype, Structure_MG, Structure_MT, category, category2)

df_outline <- df_all[, colnames(coe_all)]
df_outline <- df_outline[, apply(df_outline, 2, var) > 1e-12]
rownames(df_outline) <- df_all$ID

nrow(df_outline)
[1] 84
df_mussel_param |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Structure_MG, fill = category)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("red", "gray90", "gray", "gray60", "yellow"))
mod_pca_outline <- rda(df_outline)
PC_outline <- scores(mod_pca_outline)$sites

PC_outline <- cbind(df_mussel_param, PC_outline)

PC_outline |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = L, y = PC1)) +
  geom_point()
mod_rda_outline <- rda(df_outline ~ L, data = df_mussel_param)

RDA_outline_ind <- as.data.frame(scores(mod_rda_outline, choices = 1:3)$sites)
RDA_outline_traits <- as.data.frame(scores(mod_rda_outline, choices = 1:3)$species)

RDA_outline_traits$Trait <- row.names(RDA_outline_traits)

RDA_outline_ind <-
  cbind(df_mussel_param, RDA_outline_ind) |> 
  as.data.frame()
RDA_outline_ind |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = L, y = PC1)) +
  geom_point() ->
  PC1_vs_L

RDA_outline_ind |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = L, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point() ->
  PC2_vs_L

plot_grid(PC1_vs_L, PC2_vs_L)
RDA_outline_ind |> 
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  stat_chull(aes(color = category2), alpha = 0.01, geom = "polygon") +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Structure_MG), shape = 21, size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "yellow") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "gray", "yellow"))
RDA_outline_ind$category2 <- factor(RDA_outline_ind$category2,
                                    levels = c("MG_pure", "Hybrid", "MT_pure"))
RDA_outline_ind |> 
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0) +
  geom_density_2d_filled(
    aes(fill = after_stat(level), color = category2),
    alpha = 0.5, contour_var = "density"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = colorRampPalette(c("white", "steelblue"))(10),
    guide  = "none"
  ) +
  new_scale_fill() +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Structure_MG), shape = 21, size = 4, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "red", high = "yellow") +
  facet_wrap(~category2)
Mod_str_on_PC <- gam(Structure_MG ~ s(PC1) + s(PC2), data = RDA_outline_ind, family = "betar")

# simulateResiduals(Mod_str_on_PC, plot = T)

summary(Mod_str_on_PC)
